title: Walking Standard
summary: Therapists are expected to move around the Spa in a calm, composed, quiet, and purposeful manner that protects the peaceful atmosphere for clients.

sections.title: The Standard
paragraphs: At Zura Spa, the way therapists walk within the Spa is part of our professional image. Therapists are expected to move around the Spa in a calm, composed, quiet, and purposeful manner.

The Spa environment should always feel peaceful, organized, and relaxing. Therapists should therefore avoid rushing, running, dragging their feet, or creating unnecessary noise while moving around the premises.

sections.title: Relevance
paragraphs: Proper walking and movement are important because they:
list: Maintain the calm and relaxing atmosphere of the Spa.
Demonstrate professionalism and self-discipline.
Prevent unnecessary noise and disturbance to clients.
Reduce the risk of accidents and damage to Spa property.
Create a neat and organized appearance.
Show awareness and consideration for clients and colleagues.
Contribute to the overall Zura Spa experience.
sections.closing: A therapist's professionalism is reflected not only during a massage but also in how they carry themselves throughout the Spa.

sections.title: Therapist's Mindset
paragraphs: Therapists should have the mindset that: "I am always representing Zura Spa, even when I am simply moving from one place to another."
Walking should be intentional and composed. Being in a hurry does not justify disturbing clients or creating unnecessary noise.
Therapists should remain aware of their surroundings, particularly when clients are resting, receiving treatment, or moving through the Spa.

sections.title: What Therapists Should Do
list: Walk calmly and confidently.
Maintain good posture and a professional appearance.
Walk quietly, especially around treatment rooms.
Be aware of clients and colleagues around you.
Move with purpose rather than wandering around unnecessarily.
Give way appropriately when passing someone.
Use appropriate pathways and entrances.
Maintain awareness when carrying equipment, towels, or other items.
Move carefully to prevent slips, trips, or damage to property.
Maintain a composed presence even during busy periods.

sections.title: What Therapists Should Not Do
list: Do not run inside the Spa.
Do not stomp or drag your feet.
Do not walk loudly in areas where clients are resting.
Do not rush carelessly because you are late or in a hurry.
Do not push past clients or colleagues.
Do not block walkways or entrances unnecessarily.
Do not walk while distracted by your phone.
Do not engage in loud conversations while moving around the Spa.
Do not create unnecessary movement or disturbance during a client's session.

sections.title: Zura Spa Mindset
paragraphs: Walk calmly. Move purposefully. Be aware. Protect the atmosphere.
At Zura Spa, every movement contributes to the environment we create for our clients.
Professionalism is not only in how we work — it is also in how we carry ourselves.

remember: Walk calmly. Move purposefully. Be aware. Protect the atmosphere.
